# Third-party files in `static/`

Fetched from the npm registry by [tools/vendor_assets.py](../../tools/vendor_assets.py) at
the versions listed in [VERSIONS.txt](VERSIONS.txt). Each keeps its own licence; the full
texts are in the linked repositories.

| What | Where in `static/` | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Alpine.js | `vendor/alpine/` | MIT | https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine |
| KaTeX (script, stylesheet, fonts) | `vendor/katex/` | MIT | https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX |
| Google Sans Flex | `fonts/google-sans-flex-*` | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | https://github.com/fontsource/font-files |
| Literata | `fonts/literata-*` | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | https://github.com/fontsource/font-files |
| JetBrains Mono | `fonts/jetbrains-mono-*` | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | https://github.com/fontsource/font-files |
| Material Symbols (the icons in `icons.svg`) | `icons.svg` | Apache License 2.0 | https://github.com/marella/material-symbols |

The licence of each package is the one its npm metadata declares for the pinned version.
